name: 300a - Establish the Facts
initialPrompt: Order ORD-10428 cannot ship. Establish the facts: what was ordered, what is in stock, and who the customer is.
description: Guide 300. First interaction with order-triage, using the SQL connector only.

name: 300b - Regional Shortfall Chart
initialPrompt: Which regions are shortest on jacket inventory right now, and chart it.
description: Guide 300. Ask the Orchestrator, and watch it delegate to inventory-analyst through agent card discovery.

name: 400a - Score the Substitutes
initialPrompt: Order ORD-10428 cannot ship. Find substitutes, score them, and tell me which one to send and why.
description: Guide 400. Exercises the substitution-scoring toolset. Run it again after changing margin_impact to 0.60 and watch the recommendation flip.

name: 400b - Draft the Customer Message
initialPrompt: Draft the message to the customer for ORD-10428, offering the recommended substitute.
description: Guide 400. Exercises the meridian-customer-comms skill: brand voice and credit policy without a word of it in the agent prompt.
